A '''Vigilante mine''' was a model of [[Space mine/Legends|space mine]] developed and produced by [[Merr-Sonn Munitions, Inc./Legends|Merr-Sonn]] around [[41 ABY]] used during [[Second Galactic Civil War]] in [[Second Battle of Fondor]]. They were known for being quick and easy to lay and self-dispersing. Another feature of the Vigilante was its ability to be deactivated and picked up for later use.
